newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian helicopter crashes at sea, seven missing.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian helicopter crashes at sea, seven missing.

text.p: Seven people were missing after a Royal Malaysian Air Force helicopter crashed at sea on Wednesday night, maritime officials said on Thursday.
The helicopter with six crew was airlifting an injured Thai sailor to hospital when the crash occurred.
The officials said the helicopter went down in rough weather off Teluk Bahang in the northern island state of Penang.
The sailor, who had been scalded with hot oil, was picked up from the Thai-registered ship Jupiter II.
"The search is still on," said a maritime rescue service spokesman.
